name: Uranium-Artillery-Shell
title: Uranium Artillery Shell
author: Maximilian Priesnitz
description: Adds a uranium artillery shell with a full nuclear blast and a lingering, visible radiation field. One shell destroys a fully evolved nest; the fallout finishes off whatever the blast leaves standing, while a Geiger counter crackles if you walk into it. Nests can mutate into stronger variants (toggle in settings). Includes RadAway to cure radiation sickness.
